meta.subject: fix mask bug when writeback dirty cache line.

en.summary: Fixes dirty-victim writeback masking so miss-driven evictions use a full-line mask instead of reusing the triggering request byte mask.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly names a dirty cache-line writeback mask bug.
The patch changes L2 directory result generation in a hardware module.
The fix distinguishes hit responses from miss-driven victim writeback and forces an all-ones mask only for the miss path.
evidence: io.result.bits.mask changes from always using io.read.bits.mask on the non-flush path to a hit-sensitive mux that emits a full-line mask on miss.
The changed signal sits beside victim tag, dirty, and way outputs in the directory result bundle.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A dirty victim eviction must write back a full cache line. The old logic reused the triggering request mask, which is correct for partial accesses on a hit but wrong for dirty victim writeback.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A miss replacement evicts a dirty line while the incoming request carries only a sub-line byte mask.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reuse the incoming request mask for dirty eviction writeback instead of forcing a full-line mask.
portability_notes: Apply this to any write-back cache that carries byte or word enables on eviction requests.
Keep the hit path unchanged so the injected fault only affects dirty victim writeback.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that forms the eviction or writeback request after tag lookup.
On the dirty miss-eviction path, drive the writeback mask from the current request mask instead of all ones.
Keep victim address and victim selection logic unchanged.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Directory_test result mask generation for dirty victim writeback
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix keeps the request mask on hits but forces a full-line mask on miss-driven victim writeback.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Replace the hit-sensitive mask mux with the older expression that always forwards io.read.bits.mask on the non-flush path.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Dirty victim lines are written back only partially, leaving stale bytes in lower memory and corrupting later refills.
evidence_for_injection: The commit message explicitly says the bug is in dirty cache-line writeback masking.
The only touched DUT file is ventus/src/L2cache/Directory_test.scala.
The patch changes io.result.bits.mask from always using io.read.bits.mask to a hit-sensitive full-line mask on miss.
notes: Map full-line mask to the target cache byte-enable granularity.
This bug is specific to write-back or eviction-style caches.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了脏 victim 回写的 mask 生成错误，使 miss 驱动的驱逐回写使用整行 mask，而不是复用触发请求的字节 mask。
why_it_counts: 提交说明明确指出脏缓存行回写的 mask bug。
补丁修改的是硬件模块中的 L2 目录结果生成逻辑。
修复后区分了 hit 响应和 miss 驱动的 victim 回写，只在 miss 路径上强制输出全 1 mask。
evidence: io.result.bits.mask 从非 flush 路径始终使用 io.read.bits.mask，改成了 miss 时输出整行 mask 的 hit-sensitive mux。
被修改的信号与 victim tag、dirty 和 victim way 一起位于目录结果 bundle 中。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 脏 victim 被驱逐时必须整行写回。旧逻辑错误复用了触发请求的 mask，这对 hit 时的部分访问是合理的，但对脏行回写是错误的。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 脏 victim 回写字节使能生成
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一次 miss 替换驱逐了脏行，而当前请求只携带子行级别的字节 mask。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在脏驱逐回写时复用当前请求 mask，而不是强制整行全使能。
portability_notes: 适用于在驱逐请求上携带字节或字使能的写回型缓存。
保持 hit 路径不变，使故障只影响脏 victim 回写。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 tag 查找后形成驱逐或回写请求的逻辑。
保持普通 hit 的 mask 逻辑不变。
在脏 miss 驱逐路径上，用当前请求 mask 替代整行全 1 mask。
保持 victim 地址和 victim 选择逻辑不变。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Directory_test 中脏 victim 回写的结果 mask 生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复后，hit 继续使用请求 mask，而 miss 驱动的 victim 回写改为整行全 1 mask。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把区分 hit 的 mask mux 改回旧表达式，使非 flush 路径始终转发 io.read.bits.mask。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 脏 victim 行只被部分写回，导致下层存储残留陈旧字节，并污染后续 refill 数据。
evidence_for_injection: 提交说明明确指出脏缓存行回写 mask 错误。
唯一被修改的 DUT 文件是 ventus/src/L2cache/Directory_test.scala。
补丁把 io.result.bits.mask 从始终使用 io.read.bits.mask 改成 miss 时输出整行 mask。
notes: 把整行 mask 映射到目标缓存自己的字节使能粒度即可。
该 bug 特定于写回或驱逐式缓存。
